discription: A bright, resonant bell-like sound using frequency modulation and a short envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.001, decay=0.8, sustain=0.0, release=0.2, modRatio=1.4, modIndex=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var carrier = SinOsc.ar(freq); var modulator = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq + (modulator * (freq * modIndex))) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
